title: The numerical inverse kinematics by Levenberg-Marquardt in KinematicChain and Robot; InverseKinematicsNumerical deprecated
author: Claude-JG
description: InverseKinematicsNumerical solved a static problem of a kinematic tree pulled to the goal, which failed for poses far from the start (12 of 40 random poses with SolveSafe). Decided: KinematicChain.InverseKinematicsNumerical (C++) and Robot.InverseKinematicsNumerical (Python), the same Levenberg-Marquardt iteration on the weighted 6D pose error with the damping E + lambda, restarts by a fixed sequence, returning (q, success, iterations); the class InverseKinematicsNumerical is deprecated and calls the C++ version.
releaseNotes: exudyn.robotics: InverseKinematicsNumerical(HT, qInitial, weights, tolerance, maxIterations, restarts) of KinematicChain (C++, about 10 us) and Robot (Python) solve the inverse kinematics of any serial robot by Levenberg-Marquardt on the weighted position and rotation error, with restarts from a fixed sequence of starts, returning (q, success, iterations); the class InverseKinematicsNumerical is deprecated and calls the C++ version.
